correctness.rationale: The projection chart recovers t from the first rank-one block (and u=1/t from the last coordinates at infinity), so counting parameters counts regular points. The differential at the stated orthonormal frame is onto before constraints; the three displayed kernel perturbations take independent values under the linearized constraints, including at m=2. After projection-data dominance, the derivative numerator has generic degree 4m-2; the simple poles are avoided and independent first and second jets give codimension two for a repeated critical root at a regular parameter. The coefficient of 1/t in the rational trace excludes criticality at infinity. For a fixed ruling U, cut membership is the irreducible Schubert divisor W intersecting U-perp nontrivially, restricted to nondegenerate W. The projector derivative has nonzero off-diagonal block. Choose nonisotropic e in U and z in U-perp with nonzero mixed pairing against that block, scale z so e+z is nonisotropic, and add a nonisotropic y in U-perp perpendicular to z. The trace derivative on span(e+z,y) is nonzero because only the mixed term contributes. Thus criticality is a proper equation on that divisor and varying t leaves a proper exceptional set. This replays RESULT.md lines 25–71; checker.py checks only four special data instances. The published ED formula specializes as stated.
